name: Lifting Scheme for 3^2 Subdivision (2D)
definition: Adjustment of 2D masks for 3^2 subdivision, where only new vertices at face centers (green) are inserted, with no vertices at edge midpoints (blue).
summary: This method adapts 2D B-spline wavelets for 3^2 subdivision by eliminating the need to compute or store edge-midpoint values, operating directly on old and face-center vertices.
